# Sources of files in `data/external/fonts`

This directory contains external fonts. The origin of each file is listed below.

## `golostext-400.ttf`

- Source: repository [googlefonts/golos-text](https://github.com/googlefonts/golos-text).
- Source description: a repository for the Golos Text family with font sources and ready-made font files.
- Direct link to the file: [GolosText-Regular.ttf](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/googlefonts/golos-text/cf2e27222937d97c2d858fff0499bcc667a64e9d/fonts/ttf/GolosText-Regular.ttf).
- File description: a static TTF for Golos Text Regular, weight 400, version 2.004.
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, [license text](licenses/Golos-Text-OFL.txt).

## `golostext-500.ttf`

- Source: repository [googlefonts/golos-text](https://github.com/googlefonts/golos-text).
- Source description: a repository for the Golos Text family with font sources and ready-made font files.
- Direct link to the file: [GolosText-Medium.ttf](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/googlefonts/golos-text/cf2e27222937d97c2d858fff0499bcc667a64e9d/fonts/ttf/GolosText-Medium.ttf).
- File description: a static TTF for Golos Text Medium, weight 500, version 2.004.
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, [license text](licenses/Golos-Text-OFL.txt).

## `jetbrainsmono-400.ttf`

- Source: repository [JetBrains/JetBrainsMono](https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono).
- Source description: a repository for the monospaced JetBrains Mono family with font sources and ready-made font files.
- Direct link to the file: [JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono/v2.304/fonts/ttf/JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf).
- File description: a static TTF for JetBrains Mono Regular, weight 400, version 2.304.
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, [license text](licenses/JetBrains-Mono-OFL.txt).

## `tabler-300.ttf`

- Source: repository [tabler/tabler-icons](https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons).
- Source description: a repository for the Tabler Icons set, also distributed as icon fonts.
- Direct link to the file: [tabler-icons-300.ttf](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tabler/icons-webfont@3.46.0/dist/fonts/tabler-icons-300.ttf).
- File description: a Tabler Icons TTF icon font from release 3.46.0, variant 300.
- License: MIT, [license text](licenses/Tabler-Icons-LICENSE.txt).
